description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseNotifier' for notification mechanisms within the Pipecat framework. It specifies the interface with asynchronous methods 'notify' and 'wait' that subclasses should implement to handle event signaling and synchronization.

classes.name: BaseNotifier
classes.description: An abstract base class providing a standard interface for notification and waiting patterns used for event coordination within Pipecat.

methods.name: notify(self)
methods.description: Abstract method intended to send a notification signal, triggering waiting coroutines or processes.

methods.name: wait(self)
methods.description: Abstract method intended to wait for a notification signal, blocking until one is received.
